answer: Give each new identity a paced spiral of admission slots instead of an instant mint. To claim a slot, the key must post an original answer that is checked against a public marble of already accepted texts; any shared phrasing voids both entries. The slot fee can be paid only from work attested in the last three epochs, so a stored walnut of idle credit cannot underwrite a farm. Every extra alias then costs unique wording, waiting time, and freshly attested earnings, which cannot be prepaid or recycled.
